Nov144:45 pmDEMO event

DEMO event Hang out Alcohol-free

Sunset walk-and-talk on Lake Monroe

  • Sat, Nov 14 · 4:45 to 6:15 pm
  • Veterans Memorial Park, Sanford · Free

Are you in?

I'm in
VKM+2023 going (DEMO)

Part of January’s lineup, which drops Tue, Dec 15 at noon (DEMO). You can save a seat now.

This one already happened. Here’s what’s next.

A slow lap of the lakefront at golden hour, with room to talk about what's next.

What's the plan

A slow, easy walk along the Sanford Riverwalk while the sun drops over Lake Monroe (sunset is around 5:32 pm). We'll talk about what happened on Nov 3, what comes next in 2027, and what you'd want this group to actually do. Feelings welcome, plans optional. Walk the whole way, or hold down a bench with us at the start.

Getting in

Slow pace, lots of stops. A few of us hold a bench at the start the whole time, so you can join the talk without the walk. Tell us what you need when you RSVP and we'll plan around it.

Details

When
Sat, Nov 14 · 4:45 to 6:15 pm
Where

Veterans Memorial Park, on Lake Monroe in downtown Sanford

Meet at the park on the lakefront, then we walk the Riverwalk from there. Look for the celery-green sign (DEMO).

Open in Maps

Cost
Free
Language

English and Spanish

Who it's for

14 and up. You don't have to be a member, and you don't have to be registered with any party.

Under 18? Events that end after dark, and door-knocking shifts, need a quick OK from a parent or guardian. We'll send the form when you RSVP.

Alcohol-free
All our events are alcohol-free.
Host
DEMO host · Room for 40 (DEMO)

What to bring

  • Water
  • Shoes you can walk in
  • A light layer for after sunset
  • A friend

First time? Here's what happens

  1. Tap I’m in. A first name and one way to reach you, that’s it. No account.

  2. The day before, you get one reminder with the details.

  3. Show up, look for the celery-green sign (DEMO), and someone will say hi and introduce you around.

Where the facts on this page come from

  • Sunset in Sanford (28.80 N, 81.27 W) on Sat, Nov 14, 2026 is at about 5:32 pm EST (5:31:40 pm).

    Source: api.sunrise-sunset.org

  • Veterans Memorial Park sits on the shore of Lake Monroe in Sanford.

    Source: sanfordfl.gov

Links checked Nov 9, 2026.

The fine print

We ask before we post anyone's photo, and a parent or guardian says yes first for anyone under 18. Rather not be in pictures? Tell us at check-in.

We never collect forms, signatures or personal information at events. You do everything yourself on official sites.

Be kind, let people finish their sentences, and look out for each other. Anyone who harasses someone is asked to leave.
